messages.subject: Re: [tsDyn] Problem with selecSETAR()
messages.body_plain:
Hi

Sorry for not responding earlier.

Your problem is actually more related to use of R than to the package specifically. If you want such a loop keep more than the latest evaluation, for sure you should index the assignement, i.e.:
instead of
search<-
use:
search[i]<-

Now the optimal way of doing this might me rather to define it as a list:
search<-list()
search[[i]]<-...

if you need only AIC/BIC infos, rather do:
search[i]<-AIC(...)

Hope this helps

Matthieu
